notes: Site: ikiru.in (Shopify, India). Access: direct HTTP fetch throughout, HTTP 200, no WAF/block; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Discovery: fetched full /collections.json (965 collections across 4 pages), /pages.json (100 pages), homepage nav links, and /search/suggest.json for 'best sellers'/'top sellers'/'popular'/'favorites'/'trending' terms. Main nav explicitly links /collections/bestsellers. Qty method: exhaustive unique-product-ID count via /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 paged to exhaustion (products_count field NOT used, per established site-specific rule that it's unreliable); cross-checked against the rendered page's own '<N> products' counter where present (matched exactly for the main Bestsellers page: page shows '427 products', products.json paging also yields 427). Sub-structure: found 9 additional merchant-curated 'Best Selling <Type>' collections (Furniture, Decor, Light, Lights & Lamps, Kitchenware, Coffee Table, Side Table, Nest of Table, Utility) discovered via collections.json -- not linked from main nav/footer but live, populated, and titled unambiguously as bestseller-type listings by the merchant's own collection titles. Each has a distinct product count (17-116), confirming they are genuinely different listings, not aliases of the master Bestsellers collection or of each other, so all are kept as separate rows under the Bestsellers concept (no is_group nesting asserted since no literal parent->child breadcrumb/menu relationship is exposed by the site -- they are flat sibling merchandising collections). Rejected candidates (investigated and excluded): 'new-festive-launches' -- its collections.json title field misleadingly reads 'Best sellers in decor', but the live rendered page's actual <title>/meta description identify it as a 'Birthday Collection - Fresh arrivals... Birthday collection on account of our one year birthday celebrations... upto 40% OFF sitewide discounts. Month long offers till end of November' -- a temporary anniversary/discount promo campaign, not a genuine bestseller merchandising PLP. 'house-of-trendz' ('The House of Trendz') -- meta description confirms this is a marketplace vendor/brand storefront ('available on Ikiru Marketplace... The House of Trendz'), not a trending-products concept. Ambiguous candidate kept with a flag: 'decor-favorites' (title 'Decor Favorites', 97 products, live since ~2026-09-03) -- no body_html/description/on-page copy beyond a plain product grid under that title; close to the brief's target term 'Customer Favorites' but scoped to decor and not explicitly described as a bestseller/popularity curation, so flagged for human confirmation rather than silently included or excluded.
